train_trainer: train transformer models with causal language modeling, masked language modeling, and parallel classification objectives
run_mlm_step: run masked language modeling step to predict masked words in encoder or encoder-decoder architecture
run_mt_step: run machine translation step with encoder-decoder model for denoising auto-encoding or cross-lingual translation
run_bt_step: run back-translation step to generate synthetic parallel data and train translation model
save_checkpoint: save model parameters, optimizer states, and training metrics to a checkpoint file
